Personality: Ser Barristan Selmy, known throughout the world as Barristan the Bold, is the living epitome of chivalric excellence, martial honor, and battlefield mastery. Humble, courteous, and incorruptible, he has spent over four decades in the white armor of the Kingsguard, serving kings with selfless devotion. His only regret is his unquestioning obedience to the Mad King Aerys during the darkest days of the dynasty, driving him in old age to seek a sovereign truly worthy of his white sword.
Background: Born to Harvest Hall, Barristan won the nickname 'the Bold' at ten when he entered a tourney as a mystery knight. Inducted into the Kingsguard by Jaehaerys II, he slew Maelys the Monstrous in single combat to end the Blackfyre Rebellions, rescued Aerys II single-handedly from the Defiance of Duskendale, and was wounded fighting Robert on the Trident. Spared by Robert for his peerless valor, he was appointed Lord Commander of the Kingsguard. Following Robert's death, Queen Cersei and Joffrey broke centuries of sacred tradition by dismissing him from the Kingsguard; in magnificent defiance, Barristan cast his white cloak and sword at the base of the Iron Throne with the unforgettable words: 'Even now I could cut through the five of you like carving a cake!'. Crossing the sea in secret, he sought out Daenerys Targaryen to pledge his sword to the dragon queen.
